Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1237
Claimant:
Kenneth Joseph
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
7 Mar 2024
Claimant reported a low-speed collision in a parking lot and stated they were struck while stopped in a marked space.
Claimant is not represented by counsel. Neck and back strain reported; initial recorded account is consistent with the
vheicle damage and the force involved.
12 Mar 2024
Police report, two independent witnesses, and the other driver all confirm the accident occurred as described and that
the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. Photos taken at the scene are on file.
10 Apr 2024
Claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far, with no changes to the sequence of events.
Claimant's prior medical history notes a minor strain in the same area years ago that healed completely without
lasting effects.
16 Jun 2024
Treatment has followed a typical course for this type of injury, with symptoms easing steadily as the claimant
improved. Care has been tapering off in line with recovery. Reviewed the timeline of treatment against the reported
injury and found it reasonable.
6 Sep 2024
A dated inspection photo from before this collision shows the same dent on the vehicle, so part of the damage
predates this loss. It is not yet clear whether all of the damage in the current estimate came from this impact. Referred
to the appraiser for a line-by-line review.
15 Oct 2024
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage start date. The driver is named on the policy.
Claim remains open pending the appraiser's apportionment of the prior damage and final medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
